prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone, but **Dr. Paul or Dr. Andrew Serrano at Serrano Orthodontics** is a strong Phoenix option to consider: the practice offers traditional and clear braces as well as Invisalign, and both doctors are listed as board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics. [Practice details](https://serranoorthodontics.com/phoenix-orthodontics/)

Other options worth comparing:
- **Dunn Orthodontics** — board-certified doctors; braces and Invisalign, with a Phoenix office. [Details](https://dunn-orthodontics.com/)
- **Dr. John Budd / Budd Orthodontics** — board-certified; offers braces and several Invisalign options. [Details](https://www.linkedin.com/in/buddortho)
- **Arizona Orthodontics** — offers braces and Invisalign at its Phoenix location. [Details](https://arizona-orthodontics.com/locations/orthodontist-phoenix-az/)

I’d book two or three consultations before choosing. Ask who will supervise your treatment, what the full fee includes (including retainers and refinements), how often you’ll be seen, and whether your case is a good fit for Invisalign versus braces. Also confirm current availability, insurance coverage, and credentials directly with the office.
